title: Mirror WorkOS data into Postgres
description: Backfill, tail the Events API, and reconcile drift on a cron, with a WorkOS webhook nudge. Join users, organizations, and memberships in SQL.

environment.name: WORKOS_API_KEY
environment.description: Secret API key (sk_...) for the WorkOS environment to mirror, from API Keys in the WorkOS Dashboard.

environment.name: WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environment.description: Signing secret of the WorkOS webhook endpoint that points at this function's /webhook route. Any placeholder works until the endpoint exists.

environment.name: WORKOS_SYNC_STATUS_TOKEN
environment.description: Bearer token that GET /status requires, since function URLs are public. Any long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.
